title: Approved local Git mutation foundation
objective: Introduce the first bounded local Git mutation surface for trusted workspace repositories: create-and-switch a new branch from an exact expected HEAD, stage or unstage an exact literal path set, and create a non-amending commit from an exact approved staged state. Every mutation must require fresh local approval, re-check expected HEAD and material state after approval, return resulting-ref evidence, and remain local-only with Git hooks, signing, editors, credential prompting, network transport, destructive history operations, and arbitrary shell execution disabled or absent.

include: git.branch.create for a new validated branch name rooted at the exact expected HEAD and switched without changing the commit tree
git.stage for explicit literal repository-relative file paths only
git.unstage for explicit literal repository-relative file paths only
git.commit for a bounded UTF-8 message without amend or signing
fresh local approval bound to workspace, repository, operation, expected HEAD, exact path set or staged-state digest, branch name or commit-message digest, and policy revision
post-approval expected-HEAD and material-state revalidation before mutation
postcondition verification of resulting HEAD, current branch, index state, and resulting commit/ref where applicable
repository-local identity requirements for commit authoring without global config inheritance
explicit disabling of Git hooks, editors, signing, credential prompting, fsmonitor, pagers, and network transport for this grain
negative qualification for path escape, stale expected HEAD, approval denial/unavailability, hook execution, configured filter drivers on staged paths, and unsupported repository operation state
Windows and Ubuntu exact-head qualification with existing read-only Git regressions retained
exclude: checkout or switch to an existing branch
reset, rebase, merge, cherry-pick, revert, stash, clean, tag mutation, or reflog mutation APIs
external clean or smudge filter execution
credential helpers or interactive credential prompting
raw shell, cmd.exe, or PowerShell authority
approval bypass or persistent approval reuse

authority_delta.filesystem: Bounded repository-local Git index, HEAD/ref, and object-database mutation inside an already trusted workspace after fresh local approval; no arbitrary filesystem grant.
authority_delta.process: No generic process authority. The existing typed Git provider may execute only fixed Git subcommands required by this grain with sanitized non-interactive configuration.
authority_delta.network: None; fetch, push, credential helpers, and Git network transport are excluded.
authority_delta.secrets: No new secret access; credential prompting/helpers and inherited secret-like environment remain unavailable.
authority_delta.approval: Fresh local approval is mandatory for every Git mutation and is bound to exact normalized mutation state.

invariants: Read-only git.status, git.diff, and git.log remain available without mutation
Every Git mutation is restricted to a repository whose canonical root remains inside the selected trusted workspace
Every mutation requires an exact expected HEAD and fails with TARGET_STALE if HEAD differs before or after approval
Approval is bound to the exact mutation target and material state; drift after approval fails closed before mutation
Path-bearing Git mutation accepts only explicit literal repository-relative paths and rejects absolute, parent-escape, NUL, pathspec-magic, and .git-control paths
Git hooks cannot execute during qualified mutations
Stage refuses paths with configured Git filter drivers so clean/smudge/process filters cannot become hidden code-execution authority
Commit uses an explicit message, disables editors and signing, does not amend, and requires repository-local author identity
No Git network operation, credential prompt/helper, fetch, push, submodule mutation, force push, reset, rebase, merge, or arbitrary Git subcommand is reachable
Public process.spawn remains restricted to the SG-000010-qualified System32 whoami.exe target and public powershell.run remains absent
No browser/UI, elevation, approval bypass, or persistent approval reuse is introduced

acceptance.claim: Exact-head tests prove approved git.branch.create creates and switches to one validated new branch rooted at the exact expected HEAD, rejects an existing/invalid branch and stale HEAD, executes no hooks, and returns verified current-branch and HEAD evidence.

Exact-head tests prove approved git.stage stages only the requested literal repository-relative paths, rejects escapes and paths with configured filter drivers, revalidates the approved worktree-diff state before mutation, and returns verified staged-state evidence.
Exact-head tests prove approved git.unstage removes only the requested literal paths from the index, revalidates the approved staged-state digest before mutation, and returns verified index evidence.

Exact-head tests prove approved git.commit creates exactly one non-amending unsigned commit from the approved staged state, with parent equal to expected HEAD, bounded explicit message, repository-local author identity, hooks/editors disabled, and verified resulting HEAD evidence.
Approval denial/unavailability and any stale HEAD, staged-state, worktree-state, branch, or unsupported repository operation state fail before mutation and preserve repository refs/index/worktree.

Tests prove fetch/push/network, credential helpers/prompts, hooks, signing, submodule mutation, destructive history operations, arbitrary Git subcommands, public PowerShell, and broader process authority remain unreachable.
Existing read-only Git operations and SG-000014/P05 regressions remain green with no authority expansion outside the bounded local Git mutation surface.
Exact-head Windows/Ubuntu Rust, Node, Governance, genuine TypeSafe Jev, Alibaba Open Code Review, exact-diff security review, and zero unresolved blocking review threads all pass.

done_when: Bounded branch-create/switch, stage, unstage, and commit operations are merged and post-merge verified with expected-HEAD and approval-drift protection, resulting-ref/index evidence, hooks/filters/network suppression, and no destructive or network Git authority.
